title: Topological fundamental groups of locally finite infinite configuration spaces and infinite braids
summary: We study the topological fundamental groups of the locally finite infinite ordered configuration space \(Conf^{lf}_\infty(\C)\) in the plane and the homotopy quotient of $Conf^{lf}_\infty$ by the canonical action of the infinite permutation group $\Aut(\N)$: \[ H^{lf}(\infty):=π_1^{\mathrm{top}}(Conf^{lf}_\infty(\C),\widetilde{\N}), \qquad B^{lf}(\infty):=π_1^{\mathrm{top}}\!\bigl(Conf^{lf}_\infty(\C)\!/\!/\Aut(\N),[e_0,\widetilde{\N}]\bigr). \] We prove that \(H^{lf}(\infty)\) and \(B^{lf}(\infty)\) are non-discrete and complete topological groups.
